story-context.title: AI Eval Harness Bones
story-context.overview: Build the first repeatable Form AI evaluation harness before any prompt mutation. This story freezes the 10-row benchmark prompt set, adds a CLI baseline runner, prepares the log.FormAiEvalRun migration, captures Category A structural metrics, and records a baseline snapshot artifact. Judge packages, semantic scoring, and statistical diffing are intentionally deferred to 6.4.3b/6.4.3c.

critical-objectives.item: Freeze benchmark version prompts-v1.0 with exactly 10 canonical prompt rows and frozen runtimeContext per row.
Store eval evidence in log.FormAiEvalRun, not log.ApiRequest.
Keep the harness production-safe: concurrency 4, retry-with-jitter, max-cost cap, checkpoint-on-halt, resume support.
Capture Category A structural metrics only in this story; leave Category B/C judge fields nullable/placeholders.
Create a baseline artifact that 6.4.2 can use to prove zero behavioural change.

constraints.item: Do NOT run Alembic commands from agent shell. Anthony applies migrations.
Do NOT alter production prompt text, capability snapshot passing, or orphan prompt files in this story.
Do NOT implement judge package generation, rubric files, judge ingest, cross-model scoring, Welch/Fisher stats, or PR-comment CI output.
Unit tests must not require live LLM calls. Use mocks/fixtures for runner and persistence behavior.
Eval data is PII-adjacent. Do not print generated synthetic names/emails in chat; keep outputs in the run artifact folder.
